gloss: to be satisfied; to feel at ease; to have one's mind put at rest

definitions.gloss: to be satisfied; to feel at ease; to have one's conscience or feelings settled
definitions.explanation: Describes the state of inner satisfaction or relief that comes when one has done what one feels is necessary or right. Very often used in the negative form {気|き}が{済|す}まない (to not feel right about something; to not be satisfied until something is done).

examples.japanese: ⟦{謝|あやま}らない→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}が{済|す}まない。
examples.english: I won't feel right until I apologize.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}しない→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}が{済|す}まない⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: I have the kind of personality that can't rest until I've checked things myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{気|き}が{済|す}んだ。
examples.english: I said everything I wanted to say and finally felt satisfied.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やらない→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}が{済|す}まない⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He's the type who won't rest until everything is perfect, so he's always working overtime.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (mind, feeling) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (to be finished, to be settled). The negative form {気|き}が{済|す}まない is far more common than the affirmative, used to express a compulsion to do something or dissatisfaction with an incomplete state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {気|き}が{済|す}まない: to not feel satisfied; to feel compelled to do something
- 〜⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}が{済|す}まない: to not feel right until one does ~
- ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{気|き}が{済|す}んだ: to finally feel at ease
- {気|き}が{済|す}む⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until one is satisfied

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}が{晴|は}れる→気が晴れる：19329_kigahareru⟧: to feel refreshed; to feel relieved — focuses on clearing negative emotions
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}する→納得する：26805_nattokusuru⟧: to be convinced; to accept — more intellectual than emotional
- ⟦{満足|まんぞく}する→満足する：22617_manzokusuru⟧: to be satisfied — more general; {気|き}が{済|す}む implies a personal compulsion being resolved
